content.what_it_is: A serial-build Makefile for FUNWAVE-TVD/FUNWAVE-GPU sources. It names the executable funwave_ser, leaves double precision and PARALLEL disabled, enables CARTESIAN and PGI macros, uses mpif90 with empty optimization/debug flags, preprocesses and compiles the standard source groups, and defines link, tarfile, clean, and clobber targets (lines 1-112).
entities: Core shell, preprocessor, and executable variables (lines 1-4)
Precision and feature macro selection block (lines 5-30)
Compiler definitions with empty optimization flags (lines 31-44)
.F to .o preprocessing and compilation suffix rule (lines 63-71)
FUNWAVE-TVD MODS and MAIN source groups (lines 72-87)

unresolved: CPPARGS references FLAG_1 through FLAG_24, but most are commented out and FLAG_5 plus FLAG_22-FLAG_24 have no definitions in this Makefile (lines 11-30, 48-54); their empty or externally supplied resolution is not documented.

INCS and LIBS definitions are commented out (lines 59-60), and LDFLAGS is not defined in this file, although the compile/link recipes reference INCS, LDFLAGS, and LIBS (lines 70, 93); their external or empty resolution is unspecified.

The file and executable are designated serial and PARALLEL is disabled (lines 4, 12), but FC is the MPI wrapper mpif90 (line 36); the Makefile does not explain whether MPI linkage is still required for this serial build.
